about_the_game:
A fairy-tale-like game that combines elements of strategy and deck building, where you plant mushrooms on a circular field and learn more about the history of the magical forest with each step.

We decided to step away from the standard formula of deck building roguelikes with a turn-based combat system and made a peaceful game about mushrooms and magic stones. In each encounter, you will have to solve simple puzzles by planting mushrooms in a specific order to meet the requirements of mystical altars.

A fairy circle is a natural phenomenon in nature where mushrooms form rings. Inspired by this, we created a game on a circular grid where each row forms a loop. The success of the game depends on how well you use the space on the board.

Instead of building a deck of cards, you'll be building a bag of magic stones. Influence the chance of obtaining the right stones, exchange unnecessary stones for more advantageous ones, and try to find a combination that suits you. The game is heavily inspired by bag-building board games.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-650 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 TI, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB or Intel ARC A380, 6 GB
